responsibility: This file supplies libgccjit’s dummy GCC frontend and language hooks so recorded JIT activity can be replayed inside the normal GCC frontend pipeline. It defines the jit-specific attribute tables and handlers, root-table GC integration for the active playback context, diagnostic callbacks that route GCC diagnostics back into the JIT context, type-for-mode support, and LANG_HOOKS initialization/parse hooks that build common trees and trigger playback::context::replay. It owns the frontend-facing bridge that lets libgccjit masquerade as a GCC language during compilation.
